sections.title: What you know
sections.content: You know rhetorical questions from C1 Unit 4 (a question that needs no answer) and *szabad* / *nem szabad* + infinitive from A2 Unit 23.

sections.title: What is new
sections.content: This lesson adds the words for Bibó István's subject (*félelemmentesség*, *politikai hisztéria*, *emberi méltóság*, *erkölcsi tartás*). Bibó (1911–1979), a lawyer and political thinker, wrote about fear and hysteria in the politics of Eastern Europe. The known forms put the point as a question or a prohibition: *Miért félnénk a szabadságtól, ha mindenkinek jut belőle?* *A szabadságtól nem szabad félni.*
